name: B10-0380/2025 (S&D) – Situation in Colombia after the wave of recent terrorist attacks
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Colombia after the wave of recent terrorist attacks
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion on the recent wave of violence in Colombia, including the killing of a senator and attacks that left at least 18 people dead. It condemns the violence, offers sympathy to victims' families, and asks the European Union to keep giving political, financial and technical support to Colombia's peace process.

- **What changes:** Nothing legally. The Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- **Who it affects:** The EU's foreign policy chief, the European Commission, EU member states and Colombia.
- **What happens next:** The text is sent to EU institutions and to Colombia's president, government and parliament.
